question: In a certain code language, “FAMOUS” is written as “AFOMSU”, and “FINGER” is written as “IFGNRE”. How will “INVEST” be written in that language?
solution: __**Option 4**__ is the correct answer. The positional values of English alphabet is as follows: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] “FAMOUS” is written as “AFOMSU”.
